question: What causal claim is made about the speaker's knowledge of the Kaula determination in relation to the grace of the Lord of the Kaulas?
premises: The speaker addresses the Lord of the Kaulas.
The speaker claims to have come to know the Kaula determination.
That knowledge is attributed to the Lord's grace.
inference: The Kaula determination is known to the speaker solely by the grace of the Lord of the Kaulas.
uncertainties: The extent or depth of that knowledge is not specified.
plain_english: By your grace, O Lord of the Kaulas, I have come to know the determination of the Kaula.
